dct_creator_sm: Van De Ven, Cole (Queen's University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2284-9120
dct_description_sm: This dataset includes processed gas injection images to support the analysis presented in "Overcoming the model-data-fit problem in porous media: A quantitative method to compare invasion-percolation models to high-resolution data". Images are presented as processed saturations, following post-processing quality assurance and Light Transmission Methods (LTM) conversion. Images are in chronological order from the beginning of injection. The timestamp presented in the file name are global times therefore, change in time can be calculated from the beginning of injection.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Overcoming the model-data-fit problem in porous media: A quantitative method to compare invasion-percolation models to high-resolution data
